reason: A DeepSeek Harness web UI theme plugin that applies a dark surveillance-HUD visual skin and adds a live panel for session and tool telemetry.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供深色科幻 HUD 主题，并显示会话、上下文和工具调用遥测信息。
summaries.en: Applies a dark surveillance-HUD theme to the DeepSeek Harness web UI and displays live session, context, and tool-call telemetry.

capabilities: Overrides web UI theme tokens and styles
Injects and removes a floating telemetry panel
Displays runtime session, context, throughput, and tool-call status data
